slides.title: Equal lows = a pool of sell stops
slides.body: Below 24,390 sit the stops of every long and the entries of breakout sellers. When price trades there, those orders turn into market sells.
slides.tip: Liquidity is not a level to fear. It's fuel someone needs.

slides.title: Record volume. No follow-through
slides.body: The bar trades 4,800 contracts with stacked sell imbalances and delta -2,100, yet it closes back above the lows. Passive buyers took the other side.

slides.title: The reclaim: initiative buyers step in
slides.body: Next bar the ask lifts at 3x or more the bid one tick below, three prices in a row, and delta turns positive. That's the entry, not the wick.

slides.title: Real breakdown? Value builds below
slides.body: If volume keeps printing under the lows, delta stays negative and price can't get back above 24,390, the sellers were right. No long.
slides.tip: Acceptance below = trend. Rejection back above = climax.

caption:
The biggest bar at the low is often the END 🎯

When price sweeps equal lows, the stops underneath become market sells, so volume and negative delta explode. That alone doesn't mean sellers are winning. On the sweep bar the footprint printed 4,800 contracts, stacked sell imbalances and delta -2,100, but the bar closed back above 24,390: passive buyers absorbed the selling. The next bar showed initiative buyers lifting the ask at 3x the bid one tick below, three prices in a row. A real breakdown looks different: value builds below the lows and delta stays negative.

1️⃣ Equal lows = sell stops waiting to become market orders
2️⃣ Record volume + heavy negative delta + close back above = climax and absorption
3️⃣ Enter on the reclaim with stacked buy imbalances and positive delta
4️⃣ Acceptance below the lows = breakdown, no long
